samples: MUG_FLAVOR_TEXT: "莫卧儿王朝曾是伊斯兰世界对抗东方孔门、佛教追随者的坚实堡垒，其统治王朝更参与过全部四次对西秦的”正义吉哈德“。但大帝国不能仅靠历史的辉光存在下去。其死亡往往就是由历史的厚重压得粉碎。如今的莫卧儿就是这样一个过去多于未来的国度。腐败、酒精、鸦片、外国干涉和南方的明朝殖民地。这一切都让莫卧儿的突厥-蒙古统治集团以一种前所未有的历史速度滑向失败的一方。或许他们应该进一步倚重法国的帮助，以对抗日益膨胀的东方天朝，抑或完全相反，乃至自力更生。但是历史不会给他们斟酌的时间......"

je_federation_of_india_reason: "[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_federation_of_india_intro_text')]

Whilst this [concept_journal_entry] is active, [concept_princely_state] [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')] with low [concept_liberty_desire] and high [concept_relations] will occasionally petition for accession into the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_federation_union')].

#b The [concept_privy_purse]:#!
The former rulers of the #b Princely States#! will be entitled to a state pension as compensation for accession to the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_federation_union')]. The $concept_privy_purse$ payments will add #b National Expenses#! of @money![GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('privy_purse_multiplier_base')|D-] times the number of #b Princely States#! annexed using this [concept_journal_entry].[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_federation_of_india_diploplay_text')]"

je_mughal_hindustan_reason: "The lords of [SCOPE.sCountry('mughal_scope').GetName] once ruled from Kabul to the Carnatic coast, but that golden age has long since passed. [SCOPE.sCountry('bic_scope').GetName]'s power steadily grows, each year asserting new prerogatives of its own and denying our court more and more of the authority, prestige, and traditions it once enjoyed. Now the great scions of Timur scarcely wield any power beyond the walls of the Red Fort of Delhi!\n\n#N #bold We must act to save [SCOPE.sCountry('mughal_scope').GetNameNoFormatting], lest it slide into oblivion.#!#!"
